corpus: Six 512x512 RGB UCT-named fixtures from the repository tracked visual_gallery originals.
exactness: The six RGB arrays are available and pixel hashes verified. Four historical PNG byte hashes match the tracked references; Couple and Girl historical PNG bytes differ and are not recoverable from the repository, although their pixel arrays match the verified reconstruction references.

entries.preprocessing: RGB pixels used as stored; no resize, crop, or color transform in the run input preparation. Reconstruction helper re-encodes PNG but verifies array equality.
entries.source_lineage: Repository visual_gallery original PNG; named UCT fixture. The complete upstream source/license record is not present in this repository.
entries.redistribution_note: The exact tracked reference file is already part of this repository; upstream redistribution/license status is undocumented here.
